text:
sara: Quick follow-up from the DB fail postmortem — I'm collecting who owns which actionable and expected ETA. Please confirm ownership and add Jira links. Short thread so we can close loop before sprint planning.

devon: I can own the KV cache eviction fix (root cause was stale TTLs under heavy fanout). R=devon, A=sara, C=kevin, I=lenora. I'll spin up a branch and draft tests. ETA: end of this week.

kevin: +1 devon. Please add unit tests and a small perf test harness. I can review but won't be owner.

devon: creating ticket now -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-4123 (draft). Will move to "In Progress" once branch exists.

lenora: I will own the postmortem doc updates and the rollout plan (canary schedule). R=lenora, A=sara, C=priya, I=all. Target: Monday EOD.

priya: I can add the alerting rule change to prevent noisy retries. Will link a ticket shortly.

oncall-bot: Reminder: RDW-4123 assigned to devon is due in 3 days (auto-reminder).

sara: Thanks — can we capture the acceptance criteria here so we can close tickets when done? Minimal AC: 1) eviction TTL corrected and covered by unit test, 2) perf regression <2% on 99p latency, 3) canary for 24h with rollback signal, 4) updated postmortem doc with RCA and owner lines.

devon: Adding AC to RDW-4123 now. Also pushing a short checklist to the PR template:

```
- [ ] TTL fix merged
- [ ] unit tests
- [ ] perf harness results attached
- [ ] canary config + rollback thresholds
- [ ] postmortem doc updated
```

kevin: Suggest we add a short mitigation task owner to the RACI for immediate rollout if seen in prod again — maybe a runbook step that oncall can execute. I can draft runbook.

lenora: Good call. kevin, assign yourself RDW-4124 "runbook + emergency rollback" and link it in the postmortem.

kevin: done -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-4124. Estimated 1 day.

sara: Perfect. Last ask: devon/lenora, please add the Jira tickets to the postmortem doc and update the "Owners" table with RACI and clear due date (YYYY-MM-DD). I'll close loop in planning.

devon: will do today. tagging @kevin for review once tests are up. :thumbsup:

lenora: added tickets + RACI table. Set due date 2026-04-05.

priya: created RDW-4125 for alert tuning and linked it in the doc. ETA Wed.

oncall-bot: Note: RDW-4123 (devon) and RDW-4124 (kevin) set to high priority by sara.

sara: thanks everyone — recording this thread into the postmortem actions section. If anything slips, escalate in #postmortems. Closing thread after QA verification. :wave:
